title: You can have a crown… and still have no authority.
paragraphs: You can have a crown… and still have no authority.
Let that sit.
Because in the Kingdom of God, noise is not power. Position is not authority. Even gifting is not proof.
True authority is not announced. It is recognized—by heaven.

Look at Luke 10:19—Jesus says, “I have given you authority…”
Not earned.
Given.
But here’s what we miss…
Authority in the Kingdom is not rooted in volume—it’s rooted in alignment.
You can cast out demons and still be unknown in heaven. (See Acts 19:15)
That’s terrifying.
Because real authority flows from one place only:
Intimacy with Jesus.

Not platform.
Not followers.
Not how loud you pray.
But whether your life is submitted to the King.
Let me say it straight.

The sons of Sceva used the name of Jesus.
But they didn’t belong to Him.
And hell knew the difference.
Here’s the foundation:

1. Surrender before power
Jesus didn’t say “build influence.”
He said “deny yourself.” (Matthew 16:24)
Authority is built on a crucified life.

2. Obedience over charisma
In Matthew 7:22–23, people prophesied, cast out demons…
But Jesus said, “I never knew you.”

Gifts can function without relationship.
Authority cannot.

3. Identity anchored in Christ
You don’t fight for authority.
You operate from it—because you are in Him.
As Colossians 2:10 says, “You have been given fullness in Christ, who is the head over every power…”
But here’s where grace walks in.

Maybe you’ve been striving.
Performing.
Trying to sound powerful… but feeling empty inside.
Listen.
Jesus is not looking for impressive vessels.
He’s looking for surrendered ones.
Because the authority you’re chasing…
…is already available at the feet of Christ.
Come back to Him.
Not for power.
But for presence.
And authority will follow.
We tell the stories that shame tried to erase.
